descriptions.zh: 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知。
descriptions.en: This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the system returns a job ID and queues the job for asynchronous processing. Once the job is complete, the system sends the final result through a callback notification.
